contracts.name: Linoleus, the Verdant
contracts.printedText:
Adamant.
As long as Linoleus is on the field, whenever you gain Points due to other cards or effects, you gain 5 Points and another target manifestation you control on the field gains +1 power.
contracts.printedParagraph: As long as Linoleus is on the field, whenever you gain Points due to other cards or effects, you gain 5 Points and another target manifestation you control on the field gains +1 power.

contracts.name: Tombloom
contracts.printedText: When Tombloom is discarded, exile it. A target Manifestation on the field gets -2 power until the end of the turn.
contracts.printedParagraph: When Tombloom is discarded, exile it. A target Manifestation on the field gets -2 power until the end of the turn.

contracts.name: Incite to Sacrifice
contracts.printedText:
You can play this card only during the Reaction.
A target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone gets +6 power.
If that manifestation wins the confrontation, exile it.
contracts.printedParagraph: A target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone gets +6 power.

contracts.name: Stormmace
contracts.printedText:
Support from hand; Float.
As long as Stormmace is in the Interzone, you may Sacrifice it: The First Manifestation you control gets +2 power and gains Protection from cards and effects controlled by opponents until the end of the turn.
contracts.printedParagraph: As long as Stormmace is in the Interzone, you may Sacrifice it: The First Manifestation you control gets +2 power and gains Protection from cards and effects controlled by opponents until the end of the turn.

contracts.name: Kaos Bro
contracts.printedText:
Support from hand.
Cannot be played as First Manifestation.
When Kaos Bro is about to enter the Confrontation Zone, choose a card on the field controlled by each player. Roll a D6 for each one of those cards and, if you roll a 1 or a 6, destroy that card.
contracts.printedParagraph: When Kaos Bro is about to enter the Confrontation Zone, choose a card on the field controlled by each player. Roll a D6 for each one of those cards and, if you roll a 1 or a 6, destroy that card.

contracts.name: Karma Bro
contracts.printedText:
Support from hand.
Cannot be played as First Manifestation.
When Karma Bro is about to enter the Confrontation Zone, choose a card on the field controlled by each player. Roll a D6 for each one of those cards. You gain 10 points for each 1 or 6 you get from the rolls.
contracts.printedParagraph: When Karma Bro is about to enter the Confrontation Zone, choose a card on the field controlled by each player. Roll a D6 for each one of those cards. You gain 10 points for each 1 or 6 you get from the rolls.

contracts.name: Shattering the Self
contracts.printedText: A target player discards 3 cards from the top of the deck, then a target manifestation on the field controlled by an opponent gets -1 power for each manifestation discarded this way.
contracts.printedParagraph: A target player discards 3 cards from the top of the deck, then a target manifestation on the field controlled by an opponent gets -1 power for each manifestation discarded this way.

contracts.name: Paciphint, the Pious
contracts.printedText:
Paciphint enters the field with 2 Flower Counters on it.
As long as Paciphint is on the field, during Reaction you may remove 1 Flower Counter: Put a manifestation on the field you control other than Paciphint on the bottom of its owner's deck. If you do, the power of a target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone is not considered for the resolution of the confrontation.
As long as Paciphint is in the Interzone, whenever you lose a confrontation, put 1 Flower Counter on it.
contracts.printedParagraph: As long as Paciphint is on the field, during Reaction you may remove 1 Flower Counter: Put a manifestation on the field you control other than Paciphint on the bottom of its owner's deck. If you do, the power of a target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone is not considered for the resolution of the confrontation.

contracts.name: Hyperuranic Tower
contracts.printedText:
When Hyperuranic Tower enters the field, put 3 Abstraction counters on it.
Pay 💧: Move an Abstraction counter from a target card you control to a target Manifestation on the field.
Manifestations you control with one or more Abstraction counters gain Float.
Manifestations with Float you control on the field get +1 power.
contracts.printedParagraph: Pay 💧: Move an Abstraction counter from a target card you control to a target Manifestation on the field.

contracts.name: Dominate the Aspects
contracts.printedText:
Exchange the control of a target manifestation you control in the Confrontation Zone with a target manifestation controlled by an opponent in the Confrontation Zone.
At the Resolution, every manifestation on the field exchanged this way is put on the bottom of its owner's deck.
contracts.printedParagraph: Exchange the control of a target manifestation you control in the Confrontation Zone with a target manifestation controlled by an opponent in the Confrontation Zone.

contracts.name: Invert Emotions
contracts.printedText: Exchange control of a target manifestation in an opponent's Interzone and a target manifestation in your Interzone.
contracts.printedParagraph: Exchange control of a target manifestation in an opponent's Interzone and a target manifestation in your Interzone.

contracts.name: Induce Desertion
contracts.printedText: A target Manifestation in the Confrontation Zone loses power equal to the base power of another target Manifestation in Support under the control of the same player.
contracts.printedParagraph: A target Manifestation in the Confrontation Zone loses power equal to the base power of another target Manifestation in Support under the control of the same player.

contracts.name: Multicastigate
contracts.printedText:
You may pay 3 extra 🔘 essences to play this Will.
Destroy a target Manifestation in Support.
If you paid the extra essences, Destroy 2 target Manifestations in Support instead.
contracts.printedParagraph: You may pay 3 extra 🔘 essences to play this Will.
